mechanics.title: Toggle
mechanics.description: Press the Auto-Run key; if you were holding a direction when activating, you auto-walk that way. Pressing sprint while auto-walking makes you sprint.

mechanics.title: Options
mechanics.description: Always sprint, auto jump while active, persist across dimensions/servers/respawns, and show a toggle message.

commands_and_keybinds: V - toggle Auto-Run (default; was O in older versions; rebindable in Controls)
editor_notes: Author warns that Mod Menu without Cloth Config crashes when configuring Auto-Run; check that Cloth Config is in the pack.
name: AutoRun (Fabric)
summary: Toggle hands-free walking and sprinting with a single key. Auto-run can optionally always sprint, auto jump, and persist across dimensions, servers and respawns.
